_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table
units.tempdiff: deg C = x (a difference of two temperatures)

0EF5.name: BattTempHeatFactor
0EF5.desc: Battery temperature model: factor on the excess above 110 against coolant (engine heat), into BattTempStored; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

4064.name: ResetCoolantInit
4064.desc: At reset: IdleRpmRefStart against start coolant temperature; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

4070.name: FlexLearnEthanolCurve
4070.desc: Flex-fuel learning: curve from FlexLearnLevel1/FlexLearnLevel2 to FlexLearnEthanol1/FlexLearnEthanol2

4094.name: CrankEthanolScale
4094.desc: Cranking: flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of CrankEthanolCoolant

04A1.name: PartThrottleMapScale
04A1.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

0495.name: DecelMapScale
0495.desc: Corrected MAP to row position of DecelMapRpmLimit

0FB2.name: FlexEthanolScale
0FB2.desc: Flex-fuel: ethanol content (FlexEthanol) to the scaled value FlexEthanolScaled used as table input

0F9A.name: DecelLeanRpmScale
0F9A.desc: Deceleration enleanment: rpm to row position of DecelLeanAirflow

0FA6.name: DecelLeanThrottleScale
0FA6.desc: Deceleration enleanment: throttle opening to column position of DecelLeanAirflow

04DD.name: DecelLeanTimeScale
04DD.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

42EC.name: PurgeFuelMapScale
42EC.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: MAP to row position of PurgeFuelBase

42E2.name: PurgeFuelRpm
42E2.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: engine rpm to column position of PurgeFuelBase

4118.name: CoolantSparkMapScale
4118.desc: MAP to row position of CoolantSparkMap

04D1.name: AirTempSparkMapScale
04D1.desc: MAP to row position of AirTempSparkMapRpm

04E9.name: AfterStartSparkMapScale
04E9.desc: MAP to row position of AfterStartSparkMapRpm

0501.name: MisfireCoolantLoadScale
0501.desc: Load to row position of MisfireThreshCoolant

04AD.name: SurgeDecayGearScale
04AD.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm/speed ratio (gear) to row position of SurgeDecay

0531.name: IacRollThrottleScale
0531.desc: IAC target while rolling: throttle opening to row position of IacRollThrottleRpm

04C5.name: IacCoastSpeedScale
04C5.desc: Vehicle speed to row position of IacCoastSpeedRpm

4353.name: IacFieldDutyScale
4353.desc: Filtered duty of the CS2 input $106E.5 (probably the generator field) to row position of IacFieldDutyRpm

435F.name: IacBaroScale
435F.desc: Barometric pressure to row position of IacBaseBaroTarget and IacBaseBaroTarget2

059C.name: CrankPulseCoolantFactor
059C.desc: Factor on the cranking pulse against the cranking coolant, result into CrankPulseCoolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

05CE.name: CrankBasePulse
05CE.desc: Cranking base pulse width: ethanol content (FlexEthanolScaled, rows) x cranking coolant temperature (columns); squared, then reduced by the decay factors below; into CrankPulse

056C.name: CrankRpmDecay
056C.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm, throttle not closed; weighted by CrankRpmDecayWeight

0576.name: CrankRpmDecayClosed
0576.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm with the throttle closed

058C.name: CrankRpmDecayWeight
058C.desc: Weight of the rpm reduction against the cranking coolant

0594.name: CrankV0769Decay
0594.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against CrankDecayIndex; weighted by CrankV0769DecayWeight

0545.name: CrankVacuumFactor
0545.desc: Cranking pulse factor against manifold vacuum

05AD.name: CrankEthanolCoolant
05AD.desc: Cranking: value against ethanol content and coolant into CrankEthanolFactor

064F.name: CrankCoolantAdder
064F.desc: Cranking: added to the coolant temperature against the number of crank events (CrankEvents), limited to $0B75; result is the cranking coolant CrankCoolant

0658.name: InjectorDeadTime
0658.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

147E.name: InjectionModeRpmFactor
147E.desc: Factor against rpm on the bank pulse (FuelPulseBank1 / FuelPulseBank2) during the change of injection mode in FuelEventSchedule

07D5.name: PartThrottleFuel
07D5.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0E70.name: DecelBaroMapOffset
0E70.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before DecelMapScale

0A21.name: DecelMapRpmLimit
0A21.desc: Deceleration fuel reduction: MAP x rpm threshold; with the throttle closed, values under it ramp DecelFuelFactor (DecelFuelFactor) in

1A13.name: FuelEventRpmAdder
1A13.desc: Pulse width added against rpm while SparkFlags2 bit 7 is set (result x 8)

0F61.name: WotTimeEnrichMax
0F61.desc: Maximum of the WOT enrichment that builds up after a sustained WOT (WotTimeEnrich), against rpm

0728.name: WotFuel
0728.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0EC3.name: TpsFilterRiseCoolant
0EC3.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast (TpsFilterCoef) while the throttle opens, against coolant at start

0452.name: ResetCoolantFuelInit
0452.desc: At reset: ResetCoolantFuel (cranking fuel set-up) against coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0FBC.name: DecelLeanThrottleCoolantFactor
0FBC.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the throttle-closing term against coolant at start, into DecelLeanThrottleFactor

0FCE.name: DecelLeanMapCoolantFactor
0FCE.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the MAP-drop term against coolant at start, into DecelLeanMapFactor

0F86.name: MapFilterFallCoolant
0F86.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast (MapFilterCoef) while MAP falls, against coolant at start

0F77.name: TpsFilterFallCoolant
0F77.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast (TpsFilterCoef) while the throttle closes, against coolant at start

4054.name: ResetCoolantInit2
4054.desc: At reset: ResetCoolant2 against coolant temperature; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0F8E.name: DecelLeanBaroFactor
0F8E.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against barometric pressure; the result, limited by $158A, is DecelLeanFuel; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0FE0.name: DecelLeanMapAdder
0FE0.desc: Deceleration enleanment: added to DecelLeanRpmFactor against MAP

0FF4.name: DecelLeanRpmFactor
0FF4.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against rpm (with DecelLeanMapAdder)

1008.name: DecelLeanAirflow
1008.desc: Deceleration enleanment: airflow value against rpm and throttle position; the drop between last and current throttle goes to DecelLeanAir

10A4.name: DecelLeanTimeCoolant
10A4.desc: Deceleration enleanment shortly after start: time x coolant at start, into DecelLeanTimeFactor

0F2C.name: EventFuelCoolantSub
0F2C.desc: Per-event fuel: amount subtracted from FuelPulseAdder against coolant while FuelModeFlags bit 7 is set

12DF.name: O2VoltageScale2
12DF.desc: Second copy of the O2 voltage scale (same values as O2VoltageScale)

1199.name: DecelCutRpmFactor
1199.desc: Factor on the fuel pulse while the deceleration cut-off flag (FuelModeFlags2 bit 7) is set, against rpm above the idle target

1427.name: PurgeFuelBase
1427.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction base against MAP (rows) and rpm (columns, normalised lookup); multiplied by the learned vapor value PurgeVaporClosed

1691.name: CoolantSparkMap
1691.desc: Spark change against MAP (rows) and coolant (columns), signed

1B09.name: AirTempSparkFactor
1B09.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMapRpm against intake air temperature (or BatteryTemp with calibration bit $0330.5 clear)

1AB4.name: AirTempSparkMapRpm
1AB4.desc: Spark change for intake air temperature, MAP x rpm (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor

1A21.name: AfterStartSparkCoolant
1A21.desc: Spark change after start against the coolant temperature at start, into AfterStartSparkStart

1958.name: AfterStartSparkMapRpm
1958.desc: Spark change after start, MAP x rpm (signed), weighted by AfterStartSparkCoolantWeight

19FD.name: DecelSpark
19FD.desc: Spark change against the deceleration fuel factor (DecelFuelFactor), signed

1A0B.name: HighSpeedSparkRpm
1A0B.desc: Spark retard against engine rpm above coarse vehicle speed $1FA6 (hysteresis $1FA5)

1D4A.name: EventSparkThrottle
1D4A.desc: Upper limit of the event spark EventSpark against throttle while EventSparkFlags bits 4 and 2 are set (raised by $205D per loop)

1D54.name: EventSparkThrottle2
1D54.desc: As EventSparkThrottle while EventSparkFlags bit 3 is set (raised by $205E per loop)

1BBB.name: SurgeJerkRetardOpen
1BBB.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: retard against positive rpm jerk (above $2173)

1BC3.name: SurgeJerkAdvanceOpen
1BC3.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: spark against negative rpm jerk (below $2172)

1BF3.name: SurgeRateThreshold
1BF3.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm acceleration (RpmAccel) that starts the retard, against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1C01.name: SurgeRetardGearFactor
1C01.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the base retard against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1BDB.name: SurgeRetardRateFactor
1BDB.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against rpm acceleration RpmAccel

1BE7.name: SurgeRetardMapRiseFactor
1BE7.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against MAP rise MapRise (MAP minus filtered MAP); result into SurgeRetard

1B76.name: SurgeDecay
1B76.desc: Driveline surge spark control: decay factor of the retard against gear (rows) and time in the decay stage SurgeStageTime (columns)

1C0F.name: SurgeJerkThreshold
1C0F.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm jerk (RpmJerk) above which the jerk retard applies, against the rpm/speed ratio

1BAF.name: SurgeRetardCoolantFactor
1BAF.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against coolant

1B34.name: SurgeJerkGain
1B34.desc: Driveline surge spark control: jerk retard gain against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns)

1B13.name: SurgeJerkLimit
1B13.desc: Driveline surge spark control: limit of the jerk retard against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns), into SurgeJerkRetard

1C59.name: AcSparkRateUp
1C59.desc: A/C spark compensation: spark against positive rpm rate RpmRate, into AcSpark

1C61.name: AcSparkRateDown
1C61.desc: As AcSparkRateUp against negative rpm rate, A/C clutch off

1C69.name: AcSparkRateDownAcOn
1C69.desc: As AcSparkRateDown with the A/C clutch on

1C71.name: AcSparkMapLimit
1C71.desc: Limit of the A/C spark compensation against MAP

16EE.name: FlexSparkMapRpm
16EE.desc: Flex-fuel spark change, MAP x rpm, minus FlexSparkValue, weighted by FlexSparkEthanolWeight

1A5A.name: FlexSparkEthanolWeight
1A5A.desc: Weight of FlexSparkMapRpm against ethanol content

1CBB.name: KnockThreshold
1CBB.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

1CD4.name: KnockRetardStep
1CD4.desc: Knock retard step against the knock signal above the threshold (KnockSignal minus KnockThresholdNow); the value is multiplied by KnockFirstStepFactor or KnockStepFactor

1CCB.name: KnockRetardMaxMap
1CCB.desc: Maximum knock retard (KnockRetardMax) against MAP (above throttle $24A5 or below rpm $24A6)

1AF3.name: AirTempSparkFactor2
1AF3.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMap against intake air temperature

1AFD.name: AirTempSparkMap
1AFD.desc: Second air-temperature spark term against MAP (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor2

1F69.name: IacGearDelayCoolant
1F69.desc: Delay timer (IacGearDelay) started when DriveFlags bit 7 sets, against coolant

1F87.name: IacGearTimeFactor
1F87.desc: Factor on IacGearTimeCoolant against the time counter IacGearTime

1F91.name: IacDroopStepCoolant
1F91.desc: IAC opening when the rpm drops below the target in gear (IdleFlags3 bit 3, DriveFlags bit 7), against coolant

1FA3.name: IacGearTimeCoolantPNAC
1FA3.desc: As IacGearTimeCoolant in P/N with A/C requested

1FAD.name: IacGearTimeFactorPNAC
1FAD.desc: As IacGearTimeFactor in P/N with A/C requested

1FCA.name: IacAcKickMap
1FCA.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch engages, against MAP (MAP latched into IacAcKickMapLatch); into IacKick

1FD2.name: IacAcKickMapLatched
1FD2.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch releases, against the MAP latched at engagement (IacAcKickMapLatch)

1FED.name: IacRunTimeAdder
1FED.desc: IAC addition against time since start

1FF5.name: IacCoastCoolant
1FF5.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against coolant; the higher of this and IacCoastSpeedRpm applies

2003.name: IacCoastThrottleLimit
2003.desc: Throttle opening limit for the coasting idle air

208F.name: IacRollSpeedBase
208F.desc: IAC target while rolling: base against vehicle speed

209B.name: IacRollFactorAcSensor
209B.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against the filtered A/C sensor AcSensorFiltered (centred on 128), with calibration bit $0331.7

20A7.name: IacRollFactorBattTemp
20A7.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against battery temperature (centred on 128); read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

20B1.name: IacRollRpmFactor2
20B1.desc: Second rolling IAC factor against segment rpm

20BB.name: IacRollRpmFactor
20BB.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against segment rpm

20C5.name: IacRollThrottleRpm
20C5.desc: IAC target while rolling: addition against throttle (rows) and segment rpm (signed); result into IacTarget limited by $2642

200D.name: IacCoastSpeedRpm
200D.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against vehicle speed (rows) and segment rpm

220F.name: IacStepBaroFactor
220F.desc: Multiplier on IAC steps and start positions against barometric pressure

2219.name: IacShiftBaroFactor
2219.desc: Multiplier on the gear-change IAC step and the initial IAC value against barometric pressure

2223.name: IacKickBaroFactor
2223.desc: Factor on the A/C and rpm-dip IAC steps against barometric pressure

206A.name: IacFieldDutyRpm
206A.desc: IAC addition against field duty (rows) and segment rpm (columns), into Scratch4

212F.name: IacFieldDutyRpm2
212F.desc: Second field-duty table against segment rpm, into Scratch7 (MAP offset for the learned idle MAP)

21DC.name: IdleMapBase
21DC.desc: Base of the idle MAP target (IdleMapTarget, via Scratch5): barometric pressure (rows) and idle target rpm (columns)

21D3.name: IacStartBaro
21D3.desc: Idle air position at reset against barometric pressure, into IdleMapLearned

21B2.name: IacBaseBaroTarget
21B2.desc: Base idle air (IAC position) against barometric pressure (rows) and the idle target (columns), into IacBase; added to the IAC target

0519.name: MisfireWeightLoadScale
0519.desc: Load to row position of MisfireWeight

27F5.name: MisfireThresh
27F5.desc: Misfire threshold of the segment-time change against load (rows) and segment rpm MisfireRpmCol (columns), P/N

28AF.name: MisfireThreshNoisy
28AF.desc: As MisfireThresh when the filtered change MisfireChangeFiltered is at or above MisfireNoiseRef

271A.name: MisfireWeight
271A.desc: Counter weight of a detected misfire (Temp4FE) against load (rows) and segment rpm (columns)

2777.name: MisfireWeight2
2777.desc: Second counter weight (Temp4FF) against the first weight and segment rpm

27D4.name: MisfireThreshCoolant
27D4.desc: Factor on the misfire threshold against load (rows) and coolant (columns), result into MisfireThreshValue

26DA.name: MisfireHoldSegRpm
26DA.desc: Hold-off after a detected misfire (MisfireHold) against segment rpm

2992.name: LdpPumpTimeByLevel
2992.desc: Leak detection pump, pump-up state: state time limit (LdpStateTime) against fuel level

2348.name: LdpPumpTimeByLevel2
2348.desc: As LdpPumpTimeByLevel with LdpFlags3 bit 1 set

3DF8.name: MapLimpFromThrottle
3DF8.desc: Substitute MAP from the throttle position when the MAP sensor has failed

4024.name: ThermistorCold
4024.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, cold range (-55 to 83 C), used after the pull-up is switched

4034.name: ThermistorHot
4034.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, hot range (13 to 127 C); coolant and intake air

4088.name: AcSensorCurve
4088.desc: A/C sensor (probably refrigerant pressure): ADC AcSensorRaw to AcSensor

409C.name: DwellRpmScale
409C.desc: Rpm to column position of DwellTime

40B0.name: DwellVoltsScale
40B0.desc: Battery voltage to row position of DwellTime

40C4.name: DwellTime
40C4.desc: Coil dwell against battery voltage and rpm (both as positions)

51ED.name: EventTimingLimit
51ED.desc: Output-compare set-up in the GPT IC1 interrupt: limit against SparkAdvanceD11 compared with RefPeriodLow

51FF.name: FuelEventOffset
51FF.desc: Per-event fuel offset against the calibration value $0A83 (or $7563 with bit $0338.2), added before the per-cylinder table $ABC3

031D.name: Options032A
031D.desc: Option byte; bit tests in the reference-event and spark code (bits 7-6: spark cap and ignition variants)

0325.name: Options0339
0325.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

031E.name: Options0331
031E.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0323.name: Options0337
0323.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0326.name: Options033A
0326.desc: Option byte (global configuration); bits used are listed with their names where known

0368.name: MtvRpmLow
0368.desc: Manifold tune valve (MtvTiming): lower switch rpm (word; $FF00 = off)

036A.name: MtvRpmHigh
036A.desc: Manifold tune valve: upper switch rpm (word)

036C.name: MtvRpmRateMin
036C.desc: Manifold tune valve: rpm change per period (MtvRpmRate) at or above which the switch time is predicted

036E.name: MtvDelay1
036E.desc: Manifold tune valve: first actuator delay taken off the predicted switch time (word)

0370.name: MtvDelay2
0370.desc: Manifold tune valve: second actuator delay (word)

0372.name: MtvDelay3
0372.desc: Manifold tune valve: third actuator delay (word)

0374.name: MtvPeriod
0374.desc: Manifold tune valve: passes per prediction step (MtvPeriodCount; also the start value at reset and the time factor in MtvRateLookup)

0375.name: MtvRpmRateMax
0375.desc: Manifold tune valve: upper limit of the rpm change per period (word)

0377.name: MtvCoolantMin
0377.desc: Manifold tune valve: coolant at or above this value (at WOT) for the rpm switching

03B7.name: FanAcSensorStage1
03B7.desc: Fan with A/C: A/C sensor at or above this value sets stage bit 1

03B8.name: FanAcSensorLow
03B8.desc: Fan with A/C: A/C sensor at or below this value starts the low-pressure delay

03B9.name: FanAcSensorStage3
03B9.desc: Fan with A/C: A/C sensor at or above this value sets stage bit 3

03BA.name: FanAcSensorStage2
03BA.desc: Fan with A/C: A/C sensor above this value sets stage bit 2

03E2.name: IacHotCoolantMin
03E2.desc: Coolant above which the hot-engine IAC handling of IdleTargetControl applies

0414.name: IacLowRpm
0414.desc: Segment rpm below which the low-rpm branch of IdleTargetControl applies

0416.name: AcCutRpmLow
0416.desc: A/C logic: engine rpm limit used in IdleTargetControl and AcCutLogic (FF00 = off)

0419.name: IacStartTimeMin
0419.desc: Time since start before the event logic of IdleTargetControl runs

041A.name: IacEventTimerInit
041A.desc: Value of the IAC event timer IacEventTimer when the gear-change IAC starts

0541.name: RunPeriodOn
0541.desc: Crank ISR (Isr_GPT_IC1): reference period (RefPeriod, word) below which the engine counts as running

0543.name: RunPeriodOff
0543.desc: Crank ISR: reference period at or above which the engine counts as stopped

0551.name: CrankCoolantFloor
0551.desc: Cranking fuel: CrankCoolant is raised to at least this value while the throttle is not closed

0552.name: CrankClearFloodThrottle
0552.desc: Cranking: throttle above this value clears the cranking pulse (clear flood)

05A9.name: FuelEventCoolantMax
05A9.desc: Per-event fuel: the coolant correction of FuelEventCalc applies below this coolant

05AA.name: FuelEventColdOffset
05AA.desc: Per-event fuel (FuelEventCalc): value minus 110 gives the cold correction step

05AB.name: FuelEventColdOffset2
05AB.desc: Per-event fuel: second value minus 110 used below FuelEventCoolantMax

05AC.name: FuelEventOffsetInAlt
05AC.desc: As FuelEventOffsetIn with calibration bit $0338.2 set

0657.name: CrankFuelCoolantMax
0657.desc: Cranking fuel: coolant above which the crank-event count is not used

0669.name: PartThrottleFuelK
0669.desc: K factor of the part-throttle base pulse width: (MAP - offset) * (256 + K) / 16

066A.name: PartThrottleFuelMapOffset
066A.desc: MAP offset of the part-throttle base pulse width

0667.name: WotFuelK
0667.desc: K factor of the WOT base pulse width

0668.name: WotFuelMapOffset
0668.desc: MAP offset of the WOT base pulse width

147B.name: FuelEventCoolantMin
147B.desc: Per-event fuel (FuelEventSchedule): runs above this coolant with the throttle not closed

147C.name: FuelEventRpmAboveIdle
147C.desc: Per-event fuel: engine rpm above the idle target by less than this value

14A0.name: HotEngineOn
14A0.desc: Hot-engine enrichment switch (0 = off); also a bit mask in FinishFuelPulse

0E67.name: DecelRampStart
0E67.desc: Decel fuel reduction (DecelFuelRampControl): starts when the drop sum is at or below this value

0E68.name: DecelRampStartHyst
0E68.desc: Hysteresis on DecelRampStart while active (DecelFlags bit 5)

0E69.name: DecelRampMin
0E69.desc: Decel fuel reduction: start value of DecelFuelRamp

0E6A.name: DecelRampMax
0E6A.desc: Decel fuel reduction: upper limit of DecelFuelRamp

0E6B.name: DecelRampRpmMin
0E6B.desc: Decel fuel reduction: below this rpm the ramp starts at DecelRampMin

0E6C.name: DecelRampStepTime
0E6C.desc: Decel fuel reduction: time between steps up (DecelRampTimer)

0E6D.name: DecelRampStep
0E6D.desc: Decel fuel reduction: step up of DecelFuelRamp

0E6E.name: DecelRampStepTimeDown
0E6E.desc: Decel fuel reduction: time between steps down

0E6F.name: DecelRampStepDown
0E6F.desc: Decel fuel reduction: step down of DecelFuelRamp

0F57.name: WotEnrichCoolantMin
0F57.desc: WOT time enrichment runs at or above this coolant

0F58.name: WotEnrichRpmMin
0F58.desc: WOT time enrichment runs at or above this engine rpm

0F59.name: WotEnrichStep
0F59.desc: WOT time enrichment: increase per step up to WotTimeEnrichMax

0F5A.name: WotEnrichDecay
0F5A.desc: WOT time enrichment: decrease of WotEnrich per step after WOT

0F5B.name: WotEnrichDecayTime
0F5B.desc: WOT time enrichment: loops between decreases (word)

0F5D.name: WotEnrichDelay
0F5D.desc: WOT time enrichment: loops at WOT before it starts (FuelModeFlags bit 0)

0F5F.name: WotEnrichTimeMax
0F5F.desc: WOT time enrichment: time at WOT (WotTimer) up to which the enrichment grows (word)

071D.name: O2FlexEthanolMin
071D.desc: Closed loop: ethanol content below which FuelModeFlags2 bit 2 is set (flex fuel)

071E.name: O2FlexOffsetStep
071E.desc: Flex trim offset: step of $19,X while it is positive or zero

071F.name: O2FlexOffsetStepNeg
071F.desc: Flex trim offset: step of $19,X while it is negative (limited to zero)

0724.name: O2FlexCellRef
0724.desc: FlexCellCheck: value compared with the bank 1 memory cells from $805A (loaded with O2FlexCellRef2)

0727.name: O2FlexCellRef2
0727.desc: FlexCellCheck: second value used with O2FlexCellRef

0720.name: O2FlexCellMask
0720.desc: Flex trim offset (O2FlexOffset): bit map of the O2 cells (bit n = cell n) whose offset $19,X is stepped with high ethanol

0ED0.name: AccelMapRiseOffset
0ED0.desc: MAP acceleration fuel: MAP rise (MAP minus MapLast) above this offset counts

0F71.name: DecelLeanMapDrop
0F71.desc: Decel enleanment: MAP drop (MapLast minus MAP) that keeps DecelLeanFlags bit 2

0F72.name: DecelLeanThrottleDrop
0F72.desc: Decel enleanment: throttle drop that keeps DecelLeanFlags bit 0

0F73.name: DecelLeanTimerMin
0F73.desc: Decel enleanment ends when DecelLeanTimer is at or below this value

0F74.name: DecelLeanGain
0F74.desc: Decel enleanment: gain on the MAP/throttle drop, in gear

0F7F.name: DecelLeanSpeedMin
0F7F.desc: Decel enleanment runs at or above this vehicle speed

0F80.name: DecelLeanRpmMin
0F80.desc: Decel enleanment runs at or above this engine rpm

0F81.name: FuelPulseMode
0F81.desc: Fuel pulse output mode; 11 selects the second branch of InputFilters

0F83.name: DecelLeanDropMin
